scene.headline: The computer got a raised
metadata: RAISED FLOOR · PRECISION AIR · CHILLED WATER

connections.why: IBM's System/360, whose design the computing frame tells, came with a planning manual for its room: a raised floor, air conditioning all year and, for the largest models, water to the processor.
The raised floor, the room's own air conditioning and water to the processor, set out for IBM's machine rooms, are the parts of today's data hall whose overhead power usage effectiveness measures.
